HOperatorTrace.projected_operator_kernel_trace.{u_2, u_3} {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] {X : Type u_3} [MeasurableSpace X]
  (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure X) (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 < V)
  (E : Submodule ℂ ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu)) [E.HasOrthogonalProjection] (u : ι → ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu))
  (hu : Orthonormal ℂ u) (hspan : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range u) = E)
  (A : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu)) :
  ∫ (x : X),
      ∑ i,
        HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b V (↑↑(u i)) (↑↑((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A) (u i))) x
          x ∂ENNReal.ofReal V • nu =
    Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp A)

DSourceKernel.source_kernel_trace_global_connection.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace X] {V : Type u_2}
  [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure X) (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) (e0 eF : V →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
  (Theta : ↥(OSourceClosure.twoMomentSource e0 eF) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu))
  (A : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu)) (F : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu)) :
  let E := DSourceKernel.sourceSpan nu e0 eF Theta;
  (∀ (T : Finset ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu)),
      (fun x => ↑↑((E T).starProjection (A F)) x) =ᵐ[nu] fun x =>
        ↑(b x) * ∫ (y : X), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b (E T) A x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y)) ∂nu) ∧
    (∀ (T : Finset ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu)),
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b (E T) A x x) nu ∧
          ∫ (x : X), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b (E T) A x x ∂nu =
            Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun T => A F - (E T).starProjection (A F)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (A F - (OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta).starProjection (A F)))

theorem ReviewM.shell_reconstruction.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace X]
  [Countable ι] (μ : Measure X) (p : ι → X → ℝ),
  ReviewM.PositivePartition p →
    ∀ (f : X → ℂ), Integrable f μ → HasSum (fun i => ∫ (x : X), ↑(p i x) * f x ∂μ) (∫ (x : X), f x ∂μ) :=
fun {X} {ι} [MeasurableSpace X] [Countable ι] μ p hp f hf =>
  have hi := fun i => ReviewM.shell_integrable μ p hp f hf i;
  have hb := fun F =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ ∫ (x : X), ‖f x‖ ∂μ)
          (Eq.symm (integral_finset_sum F fun i x => Integrable.norm (hi i)))))
      (integral_mono (integrable_finset_sum F fun i x => Integrable.norm (hi i)) (Integrable.norm hf) fun x =>
        id
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun x_1 => x_1 ≤ ‖f x‖)
                (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl F) fun x_1 a => norm_mul (↑(p x_1 x)) (f x))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun x_1 => x_1 ≤ ‖f x‖)
                  (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl F) fun x_1 a =>
                    congrArg (fun x_2 => x_2 * ‖f x‖) (Complex.norm_real (p x_1 x)))))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun x_1 => x_1 ≤ ‖f x‖)
                    (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl F) fun x_1 a => Eq.refl (|p x_1 x| * ‖f x‖))))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun x_1 => x_1 ≤ ‖f x‖)
                      (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl F) fun x_1 a =>
                        congrArg (fun x_2 => x_2 * ‖f x‖)
                          ((fun x_0 x_1 => (fun x_0 x_1 => abs_of_nonneg (hp.nonneg x_0 x_1)) x_0 x_1) x_1 x))))
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ ‖f x‖) (Eq.symm (Finset.sum_mul F (fun x_1 => p x_1 x) ‖f x‖))))
                    (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg (f x)) (ReviewM.partition_partial_le p hp F x))))))));
  have hs := summable_of_sum_le (fun i => integral_nonneg fun x => norm_nonneg (↑(p i x) * f x)) hb;
  have he := fun x =>
    have ht := HasSum.tsum_eq (HasSum.mul_right (f x) (ContinuousLinearMap.hasSum Complex.ofRealCLM (hp.mass x)));
    Eq.mp (congrArg (Eq (∑' (b : ι), ↑(p b x) * f x)) (one_mul (f x))) ht;
  Eq.mp
    (congrArg (fun x => HasSum (fun x => ∫ (a : X), ↑(p x a) * f a ∂μ) (integral μ x))
      (funext fun a => (fun x => he x) a))
    (hasSum_integral_of_summable_integral_norm hi hs)

BSourceShell.finiteKernel_trace_shells.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace X] {ι : Type u_2} [Countable ι]
  (mu : Measure X) (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) (E : Submodule ℂ ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) [FiniteDimensional ℂ ↥E]
  (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) (p : ι → X → ℝ) (hp : ReviewM.PositivePartition p) :
  Integrable (fun x => DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A x x) mu ∧
    HasSum (fun e => ∫ (x : X), ↑(p e x) * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A x x ∂mu)
      (Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp A))

theorem BSourceShell.finiteKernel_shell_cutoff_trace.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace X]
  {ι : Type u_2} [Countable ι] (mu : Measure X) (b : X → ℝ),
  (∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) →
    ∀ (E : Submodule ℂ ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ ↥E] (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu))
      (p : ι → X → ℝ),
      ReviewM.PositivePartition p →
        ∀ (omega : ℕ → X → ℂ),
          (∀ (n : ℕ), AEStronglyMeasurable (omega n) mu) →
            (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (x : X) ∂mu, ‖omega n x‖ ≤ 1) →
              (∀ᵐ (x : X) ∂mu, Tendsto (fun n => omega n x) atTop (𝓝 1)) →
                have d := fun x => DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A x x;
                HasSum (fun i => ∫ (x : X), ↑(p i x) * d x ∂mu) (Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp A)) ∧
                  (Summable fun i => ‖∫ (x : X), ↑(p i x) * d x ∂mu‖) ∧
                    ∑' (i : ι), ‖∫ (x : X), ↑(p i x) * d x ∂mu‖ ≤ ∫ (x : X), ‖d x‖ ∂mu ∧
                      Tendsto
                        (fun n =>
                          ∑' (i : ι), ‖∫ (x : X), ↑(p i x) * (omega n x * d x) ∂mu - ∫ (x : X), ↑(p i x) * d x ∂mu‖)
                        atTop (𝓝 0) :=
fun {X} [MeasurableSpace X] {ι} [Countable ι] mu b hb E [FiniteDimensional ℂ ↥E] A p hp omega hm hbound hl =>
  id
    (let d := fun x => DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A x x;
    have hd := (DSourceKernel.finiteKernel_diagonal mu b hb E A).left;
    have ht := BSourceShell.finiteKernel_trace_shells mu b hb E A p hp;
    have ha := ReviewM.positive_shell_l1 mu p hp d hd;
    ⟨ht.right,
      ⟨ha.left,
        ⟨ha.right,
          ReviewM.shell_l1_limit mu p hp (fun n x => omega n x * d x) d
            (fun n => BSourceShell.masked_integrable mu d (omega n) hd (hm n) (hbound n)) hd
            (BSourceShell.masked_diagonal_L1 mu d hd omega hm hbound hl)⟩⟩⟩)

theorem BSourceShell.finiteComplement_trace_shells.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace X]
  [inst_1 : Group X] {ι : Type u_2} [Countable ι] (mu : Measure X) (b : X → ℝ),
  (∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) →
    ∀ (E : Submodule ℂ ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional ℂ ↥E] (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu))
      (h : X → ℂ),
      h 1 = 0 →
        ∀ (p : ι → X → ℝ),
          ReviewM.PositivePartition p →
            have d := fun x => h (x * x⁻¹) - DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A x x;
            Integrable d mu ∧
              HasSum (fun i => ∫ (x : X), ↑(p i x) * d x ∂mu) (-Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp A)) ∧
                (Summable fun i => ‖∫ (x : X), ↑(p i x) * d x ∂mu‖) ∧
                  ∑' (i : ι), ‖∫ (x : X), ↑(p i x) * d x ∂mu‖ ≤ ∫ (x : X), ‖d x‖ ∂mu :=
fun {X} [MeasurableSpace X] [Group X] {ι} [Countable ι] mu b hb E [FiniteDimensional ℂ ↥E] A h h1 p hp =>
  id
    (let d := fun x => h (x * x⁻¹) - DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A x x;
    have he :=
      funext fun x =>
        of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun x_1 => x_1 x = -DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A x x)
              (funext fun x =>
                Eq.trans
                  (congrArg (fun x_1 => x_1 - DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A x x)
                    (Eq.trans (congrArg h (mul_inv_cancel x)) h1))
                  (zero_sub (DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A x x))))
            (eq_self (-DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A x x)));
    have hd :=
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Integrable _a mu) he))
        (Integrable.neg (DSourceKernel.finiteKernel_diagonal mu b hb E A).left);
    have htrace :=
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ∫ (x : X), _a x ∂mu = -Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp A)) he))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = -Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp A))
              (integral_neg fun x => DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A x x)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => -_a = -Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp A))
                (DSourceKernel.finiteKernel_trace mu b hb E A)))
            (Eq.refl (-Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp A)))));
    have ht := ReviewM.shell_reconstruction mu p hp d hd;
    have ha := ReviewM.positive_shell_l1 mu p hp d hd;
    ⟨hd,
      ⟨Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => HasSum (fun i => ∫ (x : X), ↑(p i x) * d x ∂mu) _a) htrace) ht, ⟨ha.left, ha.right⟩⟩⟩)
